payload.decision_consequence: Signal-only. This is the CRE-recognition leg of REGINALD's convergence thesis and it does not by itself authorize or size any trade, move any registered threshold, or change REGINALD trigger REG-T-07, whose bar is a different level (>15 percent, sustain 3) on the same series. The registered desk confidence of 90 percent is unchanged by this submission and is supported by the 2026-08-27 tracking read: the July 2026 office print of 11.91 percent sits 1.91 percentage points above the 10.00 percent bar and rose from 11.57 percent in June, so a NO resolution requires roughly a 191 basis point fall sustained across two consecutive months within the remaining four months of the window, against a series that is currently rising. The 10 percent residual is not zero because the series can move on composition and because a Trepp restatement or definition change is a live path.
